public_source.result: All 27 branch-tip ancestry probes returned an empty commit list for the exact path opentinker/memory_training.

finding.title: No currently listed official OpenTinker branch has reachable history for the paper-named memory_training path
finding.observation: Every one of the 27 current protected branch refs returned by the official branch inventory was queried with GitHub commits-by-path for opentinker/memory_training, and every query returned an empty list. This substantially strengthens the public-source gap: the exact path named by Auto-Dreamer Appendix E is not reachable in the ancestry of any currently listed official branch tip.
finding.scope_guard: This is exact-path, current-ref ancestry evidence as of the inspected branch inventory. It does not rule out renamed directories, deleted branch refs, force-pushed/unreachable objects, forks, author mirrors, releases, Hugging Face artifacts, private repositories, or a code release after this snapshot. It also does not imply the paper fabricated the path.

phase1_implication: The public OpenTinker repository can supply a pre-paper ScienceWorld environment precursor, but not the paper-named memory-training source via any currently listed branch ancestry. A static historical replay package therefore still requires another public source bridge before it can be accepted without execution handoff.
